description: This Java class defines a custom configuration for Feign clients within a Spring Cloud application. It extends default Feign client properties to override or add specific bean configurations, notably a custom ErrorDecoder.

classes.name: CustomFeignClientConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class to customize Feign client error handling by providing a custom ErrorDecoder bean.

methods.name: errorDecoder
methods.description: Defines a bean that provides a custom ErrorDecoder for Feign clients.
